faces.name: Propaganda

effect.reason: No record for an attack tax: CantAttack's Unless is an ObjectFilter describing a permanent, so it cannot say that the attacking creature's controller must pay {2} for each creature they control that's attacking me. There is no cost-to-attack continuous effect in the vocabulary (CostModifier is spells, AbilityCostModifier is abilities, OptionalAdditionalCost rides on spells), and no amount for "each creature they control that's attacking you" in a payment position.
effect.text: Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each creature they control that's attacking you.

effect.reason: No record imposes a cost on declaring attackers. CantAttack's "unless" is an ObjectFilter, so it can say what must exist, never that a player pays {2} per attacking creature; CostModifier and AbilityCostModifier tax spells and activated abilities rather than an attack declaration. Writing CantAttack alone would forbid the attack outright, which is a different card.
